cr.label: Canadian Pacific
dirLabels: to Cranbrook, the Crowsnest, Lethbridge and Medicine Hat

trips.name: Kootenay Express
trips.note: From Medicine Hat and Lethbridge by the Crowsnest; on to Vancouver by the Kettle Valley.

trips.name: Kettle Valley Express
trips.note: From Vancouver by the Kettle Valley; Nelson to Lethbridge by the Crowsnest, and on to Medicine Hat.
Medicine Hat to Lethbridge, daily except Sunday: the morning connection off the main line trains from the east.
Lethbridge to Medicine Hat, daily except Sunday: the evening connection for the main line trains to the east.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train from Lethbridge and Macleod to Cranbrook, where it lies over until 3.00 a.m.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Cranbrook to Yahk, connecting with the Spokane International for Spokane.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Yahk to Cranbrook and on to Macleod and Lethbridge.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Cranbrook to Lake Windermere (Mondays): by the main line to Colvalli, where it stands 25 minutes and reverses, then up the Kootenay Central through Fort Steele.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Lake Windermere to Cranbrook (Saturdays): down the Kootenay Central to Colvalli, where it stands 25 minutes and reverses, then the main line to Cranbrook.

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Lake Windermere to Golden (Tuesdays and Thursdays).

trips.name: Mixed
trips.note: Mixed train, Golden to Lake Windermere (Wednesdays and Fridays).
Trail to Castlegar, through to Nelson (Table 151).
